messages:
Rae: quick PSA - console shows a burst of requests marked as 'project:unknown' for org-sprinter around 09:02. billing mismatch reported.
Diego: sample id f1a2b3 - trace shows auth-proxy forwarded x-origin-project: inventory but authz returned no project claim.
Hannah: could be the new auth-cache eviction edge case where cached introspect result misses project on cold miss.
Ezra: can we short-term tag events with `attr_debug=cache_miss|introspect_fail|header_only` so dashboards can filter?
Rae: yes please. Add `attr_confidence=high|soft|none`. Console UX: show a red dot for none, yellow for soft.
Diego: infra note: add a 1s retry to introspect on 502s before falling back to org-only. low risk and might reduce noise.
Hannah: agree but behind flag. Also add an alert when soft attribution > 1% for any org in 5m.
alert-bot: created ticket ENG-2400 for telemetry; created alert rule "soft_attr_ratio" threshold 1%/5m.
Ezra: owners: Rae - console filter + badge, Diego - introspect retry, Hannah - telemetry schema. Timeline: telemetry today, retry behind flag this week.
Rae: I'll mock the UI and update product.
Diego: deploying small retry patch now.
Hannah: pushing schema change and parser update.
Rae: great, thanks all. we'll follow up if alert fires. :thumbsup:
